title: 2415 University Ave E - Childcare centre
body:
Application to amend zoning for 2415 University Avenue East (OPA 75, Z-26-08)
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
MHBC Planning and Creative Beginnings Early Learning & Care are proposing to expand the existing Child Care Centre located at 2415 University Ave E. The proposed development includes the Child Care Centre as a permitted primary use on the subject lands.
Official plan change requested is
to permit a child care centre as a primary use
Zoning By-law change requested is:
to permit a child care centre as a primary use
to
permit structures accessory to a Child Care Centre with a maximum Building
Floor Area of 2.0 square and a maximum height of 2.4 metres, which are fully screened,
to be setback a minimum of 1.0 metres along Northfield Drive East.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Please note this property was subject to a previous minor Zoning By-law Amendment (Z-25-11) to lift the holding symbol applied to the child care centre use, to allow an ancillary use to occupy 35% of the building floor area, and to allow an ancillary use to be on the second floor of a building.
Proposed use, Location, and Parking
Use Proposed: Child Care Centre
Unit Floor Area: 1,436 Square Metres
Unit Location: First and Second Floor
Parking: 84 Spaces (Existing)
Bicycle Parking: 7 Spaces (Existing)
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
